markdown:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about the condition of the rental car I collected from your Newark Airport branch on 2 June. The interior smelled strongly of smoke, and the tire pressure warning light was on for the entire trip.

I was charged a $150 cleaning fee when I returned the car, even though the smell was there when I picked it up. I would like this fee refunded.

Sincerely,
Martin Doyle

labels.notes: "2 June" date format in an en-US letter is unusual but not an error.
